title: Validate judge question batches without a live model
narrative: Taloneth starts the CLI host with family `pass_through` and backend `mock`. Taloneth iterates yes/no, choice, and score questions offline. Clean batches validate; missing answers must surface structured errors — including partial failure reporting — without a GPU host.
implementation:
Provider-neutral judge schema in `mechaharness.inference.judge` (`Choice`/`Noul`/`Score` questions and signals, `Judgement`, `JudgeErrorItem`, provenance). `FixtureJudgeProvider` + `judge()` validate batches and report per-question errors. Semantics cover closed-world answers, partial failure, and calibration/provenance fields adapters must map.

Covers: JDG-01, JDG-02, JDG-03, JDG-04.
validation: Harness `user_story` drives product verb(s) with environment `pass_through`/`mock`; hard expects on declared observation keys.
